title: Override Game Executable & Disable Hooks
name: exec
desc:
Path to the game DLL file.

This option is typically not needed; leave it empty to allow spice to auto-detect your game.

WARNING: this option also disables all game-specific hooks and turns off most I/O modules!

title: Open Configurator
name: cfg
desc: Opens configuration window. This can only be launched via the command line (spice -cfg or spice64 -cfg) or just launch spicecfg.exe.

title: (REMOVED) Open KFControl
name: kfcontrol
desc: This feature has been removed; please use an older version.

title: Basic Local EA Emulation
name: ea
desc: Enables the integrated local EA server, just enough to boot the game; no card in, no data saving.

title: EA Service URL
name: url
desc: Sets a custom service URL override.

title: PCBID
name: p
desc: Sets a custom PCBID override.

title: Player 1 Card
name: card0
desc: Set a card number for reader 1. Overrides the selected card file.

title: Player 2 Card
name: card1
desc: Set a card number for reader 2. Overrides the selected card file.

title: Player 1 PIN Macro
name: pinmacro0
desc: Set a PIN for Player 1 that will cause the PIN to be automatically typed when Player 1 PIN Macro overlay key is pressed.

title: Player 2 PIN Macro
name: pinmacro1
desc: Set a PIN for Player 2 that will cause the PIN to be automatically typed when Player 2 PIN Macro overlay key is pressed.

title: Player 1 PIN Macro Auto Trigger on Log
name: autopinmacrotrigger0
desc: Substring matched against game log output to detect when Player 1's PIN entry screen is ready. When the substring appears in any log line, the PIN macro is typed for Player 1 only. Leave blank to disable auto-trigger for P1.

title: Player 2 PIN Macro Auto Trigger on Log
name: autopinmacrotrigger1
desc: Substring matched against game log output to detect when Player 2's PIN entry screen is ready. When the substring appears in any log line, the PIN macro is typed for Player 2 only. Leave blank to disable auto-trigger for P2.

title: Windowed Mode
name: w
desc: Enables windowed mode.

title: Inject DLL Hooks
name: k
desc: Multiple files are allowed; use multiple -k flags, or in SpiceCfg, separate by space (foo.dll bar.dll baz.dll). Injects a hook by using LoadLibrary on the specified file before running the main game code.

title: Inject Early DLL Hooks
name: z
desc: Equivalent to 'Inject DLL Hooks' option, but ensures hooks are injected before the game module has been loaded into the process.

title: (REMOVED) Execute Lua Script
name: script
desc: This feature has been removed.

title: Lock Cursor to Window
name: c
desc: Confines the cursor to be within the game window.

title: Show Cursor & Touch Emulation Enable
name: s
desc: Shows the cursor in the game window; also turns on touch emulation. Do not enable this if you have a real touch screen.

title: Change Main Monitor
name: mainmonitor
desc:
Changes the primary monitor before launching the game. It will be restored on exit.

This may fail to work properly on hybrid laptops with iGPU + dGPU.

title: DX Primary Display Adapter Override
name: monitor
desc:
Prefer to use Change Main Monitor option instead of this one.

Sets the display that the game will be opened in, for multiple monitors.

0 is the primary monitor, 1 is the second monitor, and so on.

Not all games will respect this. Not recommended for multi-monitor games like Lightning Model / Valkyrie Model modes. Disable Full Screen Optimizations for best results.

title: Only Use Main Monitor For Full Screen
name: graphics-force-single-adapter
desc:
Force the graphics device to be opened utilizing only one adapter in multi-monitor systems.

May cause unstable framerate and desyncs, especially if monitors have different refresh rates!

title: Monitor Refresh Rate
name: graphics-force-refresh
desc: Change the refresh rate for the primary monitor before launching the game. It will be restored on exit.

title: Force Full Screen Resolution
name: forceres
desc:
For full screen mode, forcibly set a custom resolution.

Works great for some games, but can COMPLETELY BREAK other games - YMMV!

If you are using -forceresswap/-sdvxlandscape, put the TARGET monitor resolution in this field.

This should only be used as last resort if your GPU/monitor can't display the resolution required by the game.

title: Full Screen Orientation Swap (EXPERIMENTAL)
name: forceresswap
desc:
Allows you to play portrait games in landscape (and vice versa) by transposing resolution and applying image scaling.

Works great for some games, but can COMPLETELY BREAK other games - YMMV!

Strongly consider combining this with -forceres option to render at monitor native resolution.

For SDVX, use the dedicated -sdvxlandscape option.

title: Force FS Subscreen Resolution (EXPERIMENTAL)
name: forceressub
desc:
Override fullscreen resolution requested by the game for second monitor, useful if you have a sub monitor that is not quite exactly what the game expects.

WARNING: experimental as we have not done extensive testing to see if this causes desyncs.

title: Force FS Subscreen Refresh Rate (EXPERIMENTAL)
name: graphics-force-refresh-sub
desc:
Override fullscreen refresh rate requested by the game for second monitor, useful if you have a sub monitor that is not quite exactly 60Hz.

WARNING: experimental as we have not done extensive testing to see if this causes desyncs.

title: DirectX 9 on 12 (DEPRECATED - use -dx9on12 instead)
name: 9on12
desc: Use D3D9On12 wrapper library, requires Windows 10. Deprecated - use -dx9on12 instead.

title: DirectX 9 on 12
name: sp2x-dx9on12
desc:
Use D3D9On12 wrapper library, requires Windows 10. Has no effect on games that don't use DX9. Can cause some games to crash.

Default: auto (use DX9 for most games, but turn on 9on12 for games that require it on non-NVIDIA GPUs).

title: Disable Win/Media/Special Keys
name: nolegacy
desc: Disables legacy key activation in-game.

title: Discord Rich Presence
name: richpresence
desc: Enables Discord Rich Presence support.

title: Discord RPC AppID Override
name: discordappid
desc: Set the discord RPC AppID override.

title: Smart Local EA
name: smartea
desc: Automatically enables -ea when server is offline.

title: EA Maintenance (DEPRECATED - use -forceeamaint instead)
name: eamaint
desc: Enables EA Maintenance, 1 for on, 0 for off.

title: Local EA Maintenance
name: sp2x-eamaint
desc: Causes local EA to start in maintenance mode. Must be used with -ea or -smartea.

title: Preferred Network Adapter's IP
name: network
desc: Instead of using the default network adapter, force the usage of another network adapter with the specified IP address. You must also set -netadaptersubnet.

title: Preferred Network Adapter's Subnet
name: subnet
desc: Instead of using the default network adapter, force the usage of another network adapter with the specified subnet. You must also set -netadapterip.

title: Disable Network Fixes
name: netfixdisable
desc: Force disables network fixes.

title: HTTP/1.1
name: http11
desc: Sets EA3 http11 value.

title: Disable SSL Protocol
name: ssldisable
desc: Prevents the SSL protocol from being registered.

title: URL Slash
name: urlslash
desc: Sets EA3 urlslash value.

title: SOFTID
name: r
desc: Set custom SOFTID override.

title: (REMOVED) VR controls (experimental)
name: vr
desc: This feature has been removed.

title: Disable Spice Overlay
name: overlaydisable
desc: Disables the in-game overlay.

title: Overlay Keyboard Navigation
name: keyboardnav
desc: Enables keyboard navigation in the in-game overlay.

title: Spice Overlay UI Scale %
name: overlayscale
desc: Forces UI scaling for the overlay, things can look off since the UI was written for 100% scaling. Enter value in percentage, between 10-400, inclusive.

title: Notifications
name: toast
desc: Select where notifications will appear on the screen.

title: Auto Show FPS/Clock
name: sp2x-autofps
desc: Automatically show FPS / clock / timer overlay window when the game starts.

title: Show FPS/Clock top-left (DEPRECATED - use -fpslocation instead)
name: fpsflip
desc: Show FPS / clock / timer overlay on the top left of the screen instead of the top right. Deprecated - use -fpslocation instead.

title: FPS/Clock Location
name: fpslocation
desc: Select which corner of the screen the FPS / clock / timer overlay appears in.

title: Auto Show Subscreen
name: sp2x-autosubscreen
desc: Automatically show the subscreen overlay when the game starts, if the game has one.

title: Auto Show IO Panel
name: sp2x-autoiopanel
desc: Automatically show I/O panel window when the game starts.

title: Auto Show Keypad
name: sp2x-autokeypad
desc: Automatically show virtual keypad window when the game starts.

title: Force Load IIDX Module
name: iidx
desc: Manually enable Beatmania IIDX module.

title: IIDX Camera Order Flip
name: iidxflipcams
desc: Flip the camera order.

title: IIDX Disable Cameras (DEPRECATED - no longer needed)
name: iidxdisablecams
desc: Disables cameras.

title: IIDX Official AC Camera Access
name: iidxcabcams
desc:
Controls how the game accesses USB cameras for IIDX 25+.

auto (default): use [off] when the IIDX module is enabled; otherwise, use [on].

on: game discovers and directly accesses cameras; requires official cameras on correct USB ports.

legacy: for IIDX 25/26 only; allow camera access with emulated discovery.

off: prevent game from accessing USB cameras.

title: IIDX Cam Hook
name: iidxtdjcamhook
desc: Experimental camera support for IIDX 27+ via texture hooking. Requires camera(s) that support YUY2 or NV12 encoding.

title: IIDX Cam Hook Aspect Ratio
name: iidxtdjcamhookratio
desc: Determine what aspect ratio should be preferred for webcam input. Default: 16:9.

title: IIDX Cam Hook Offset Override
name: iidxtdjcamhookoffset
desc: Override DLL offsets for camera hook; format: 5 hex values separated by commas (offset_hook_a, offset_textures, offset_camera_manager, offset_d3d_device, offset_afp_texture).

title: IIDX Cam Hook Top ID
name: iidxtdjcamhooktop
desc:
Specify a partial ID of the camera to use as the TOP camera. Useful if you have more than 3 cameras and need to tell spice which ones to use.

To get IDs, launch the game and look for camera IDs from MFEnumDeviceSources.

For example, `vid_1234&pid_5678` matches on `\\?\usb#vid_1234&pid_5678&mi_00#7&234123456&1&0000#{e5323777-f976-4f5b-9b55-b94699c46e44}\global`.

title: IIDX Cam Hook Front ID
name: iidxtdjcamhookfront
desc:
Specify a partial ID of the camera to use as the FRONT camera. Useful if you have more than 3 cameras and need to tell spice which ones to use.

To get IDs, launch the game and look for camera IDs from MFEnumDeviceSources.

For example, `vid_1234&pid_5678` matches on `\\?\usb#vid_1234&pid_5678&mi_00#7&234123456&1&0000#{e5323777-f976-4f5b-9b55-b94699c46e44}\global`.

title: IIDX Sound Output Device
name: iidxsounddevice
desc: SOUND_OUTPUT_DEVICE environment variable override. Default: auto. Auto will use WASAPI, unless -iidxasio is set or if XONAR SOUND CARD is present, then ASIO is used.

title: IIDX ASIO Driver
name: iidxasio
desc:
ASIO driver name to use, replacing XONAR SOUND CARD(64). String should match registry key under HKLM\SOFTWARE\ASIO\ 

IIDX is very picky about ASIO devices it can support, YMMV.

title: IIDX BIO2 Firmware Update
name: iidxbio2fw
desc: Enables BIO2 firmware updates. WARNING - can cause semi-permanent change to your I/O board.

title: IIDX TDJ Mode (Lightning Model)
name: iidxtdj
desc: Enables TDJ mode (Lightning Model cabinet).

title: IIDX Digital TT Sensitivity
name: sp2x-iidxdigitalttsens
desc: Adjust sensitivity of turntable when digital input (buttons) is used. Does not affect analog input! Default: 4.

title: IIDX Digital TT SOCD Cleaner
name: iidxsocd
desc:
SOCD for turntables when using button input; what happens when both directions are pressed.

last: most recently pressed direction takes priority

first: first pressed direction takes priority

neutral (default): TT does not move when both directions are pressed, recommended to avoid excessive POORs.

title: IIDX LDJ Force 720p (HD)
name: sp2x-iidxldjforce720p
desc: Force Definition Type HD (720p) mode instead of FHD (1080p) for IIDX30+. Only for LDJ! TDJ is always FHD in IIDX30+.

title: IIDX TDJ Subscreen Size
name: sp2x-iidxtdjsubsize
desc: Default size of the subscreen overlay. Default: medium.

title: IIDX LED Ticker Font Size
name: sp2x-iidxledfontsize
desc: Configure the font size of the segment display, in pixels. Default: 64 (px).

title: IIDX LED Ticker Color
name: sp2x-iidxledcolor
desc: Configure the font color of the segment display; specify RGB value in hex. Default: 0xff0000 (red).

title: IIDX LED Ticker Position
name: sp2x-iidxledpos
desc: Initial position of the segment display. Default: bottom.

title: IIDX LED Ticker Borderless
name: iidxledborderless
desc: Make LED ticker overlay window borderless (remove window decoration).

title: Force Load Sound Voltex Module
name: sdvx
desc: Manually enable Sound Voltex Module.

title: SDVX Vivid Wave Force 720p Window (DEPRECATED - use -windowsize instead)
name: sdvx720
desc: Old & deprecated option for launching Vivid Wave in 720p when using windowed mode.

title: SDVX Printer Emulation
name: printer
desc: Enable Sound Voltex printer emulation.

title: SDVX Printer Output Path
name: printerpath
desc: Path to folder where images will be stored.

title: SDVX Printer Output Clear
name: printerclear
desc: Clean up saved images in the output directory on startup.

title: SDVX Printer Output Overwrite
name: printeroverwrite
desc: Always overwrite the same file in output directory.

title: SDVX Printer Output Format
name: printerformat
desc: File format for printer output.

title: SDVX Printer JPG Quality
name: printerjpgquality
desc: Quality setting in percent if JPG format is used.

title: SDVX Disable Cameras (DEPRECATED - no longer needed)
name: sdvxdisablecams
desc:
This option does nothing.

This option was used in the past to fix cameras in SDVX5 but this is no longer needed as camera check will always be skipped with a built-in patch.

title: SDVX Native Touch (DEPRECATED - no longer needed)
name: sdvxnativetouch
desc:
This option does nothing.

Native touch handling is now enabled by default and this option is no longer needed.

title: SDVX FS Subscreen Force Redraw
name: sp2x-sdvxsubredraw
desc: Check if submonitor in fullscreen mode doesn't update every frame; this option presents the subscreen when the game does not.

title: SDVX Digital Knob Sensitivity
name: sp2x-sdvxdigitalknobsens
desc: Adjust sensitivity of knobs when digital input (buttons) is used. Does not affect analog input! Default: 16.

title: SDVX Digital Knob SOCD Cleaner
name: sdvxsocd
desc:
SOCD for knobs when using button input; what happens when both directions are pressed.

last (default): most recently pressed direction takes priority, recommended to deal with slams

first: first pressed direction takes priority

neutral: knob does not move when both directions are pressed.

title: SDVX ASIO driver
name: sp2x-sdvxasio
desc:
ASIO driver name to use, replacing XONAR SOUND CARD(64). String should match registry key under HKLM\SOFTWARE\ASIO\ 

SDVX is EXTREMELY picky about ASIO devices it can support!

title: SDVX ASIO Two Channel Audio
name: sdvxasio2ch
desc: Force the game to use two channels for ASIO output.

title: SDVX Disable Live2D (EXPERIMENTAL)
name: sdvxnolive2d
desc:
Skip rendering the SDVX Live2D graphics to save GPU.

off: leave Live2D as-is.
always: hide Live2D (also hides menu navigator).
ingame: only hide Live2D during a song; keeps the menu navigator. Scene detection relies on game logging.

title: SDVX Subscreen Overlay Position
name: sp2x-sdvxsubpos
desc: Location for the subscreen overlay. Default: bottom.

title: SDVX Subscreen Monitor Override
name: sdvxsubmonitor
desc: If you have three or more monitors, this option can be set to tell the game which monitor is the subscreen.

title: Force Load DDR Module
name: ddr
desc: Manually enable Dance Dance Revolution module.

title: DDR 4:3 Mode
name: ddrsd/o
desc: Enable DDR 4:3 (SD) mode.

title: DDR Skip Codec Registration
name: ddrnocodec
desc: Prevent automatic registration of codecs in the com folder.

title: Force Load Pop'n Music Module
name: pnm
desc: Manually enable Pop'n Music module.

title: Pop'n Music Force HD Mode
name: pnmhd
desc: Force enable Pop'n Music HD mode.

title: Pop'n Music Force SD Mode
name: pnmsd
desc: Force enable Pop'n Music SD mode.

title: Pop'n Music PikaPika Subscreen Disable
name: popnnosub
desc: Prevents PikaPika model subscreen from launching a separate window.

title: Pop'n Music PikaPika Subscreen Monitor Override
name: popnsubmonitor
desc: If you have three or more monitors, this option can be set to tell the game which monitor is the subscreen.

title: Pop'n Music Native Touch (DEPRECATED - no longer needed)
name: popnnativetouch
desc:
This option does nothing.

Native touch handling is now enabled by default and this option is no longer needed.

title: Pop'n Music PikaPika Subscreen Force Redraw
name: popnsubredraw
desc: Check if submonitor in fullscreen mode appears stuck; this option presents the subscreen when the game does not.

title: Force Load HELLO! Pop'n Music Module
name: hpm
desc: Manually enable HELLO! Pop'n Music module.

title: Force Load GitaDora Module
name: gd
desc: Manually enable GitaDora module.

title: GitaDora Two Channel Audio
name: 2ch
desc: Attempt to reduce audio channels down to just two channels.

title: GitaDora Disable Frame Limiter (EXPERIMENTAL)
name: gdnoframelimiter
desc:
Only for GITADORA to GALAXY WAVE; not for XG series or Arena Model.

Game engine's built-in frame limiter can result in unstable frame pacing (around 56-58 FPS) on modern Windows. Turning this on disables that and forces the game to rely on V-Sync instead, resulting in a stable FPS.

Ensure your monitors are set to 60Hz.

title: GitaDora Cabinet Type
name: gdcabtype
desc: Select cabinet type. DX has more input and lights. Pick SD2 for single player guitar mode on white cab.

title: GitaDora Lefty Guitar (for Digital Wailing)
name: gdlefty
desc:
Enables lefty mode, flipping motion sensor directions. Default: off.

Without this option, enabling LEFT in the game option will continuously trigger UP wail.

Has no effect if you are using analog bindings for X/Y axis; most controllers do not handle this correctly.

As always, remember to restart the game after changing options. If you need to change in the game, use the I/O panel overlay window.

title: GitaDora Digital Wail Hold
name: gdwailhold
desc:
For digital wail input, how long (in milliseconds) to hold the wail state. Practically, this controls how sensitive wailing is.

Default: 100 (ms)

If set to 0, no hold will occur, which means you need to press the wail button longer to register; default value of 100ms will cause the game to trigger wail even on a light tap of the button.

title: GitaDora Picking Algorithm
name: gdpickalgo
desc:
Select picking algorithm for guitar.

recent (default): use SOCD cleaner algorithm that prioritizes recent input

legacy: only the rising edge of the pick input is considered; cannot hold pick for menu navigation

neutral: if both up and down are pressed, they cancel out

raw: no filtering done by spice; game receives both input as-is, possible to input both up and down at the same time

title: GitaDora Subscreen Overlay Size
name: gdsubsize
desc: Default size of the subscreen overlay. Default: medium.

title: GitaDora Arena Disable Subscreens (DEPRECATED - use -gdalayout)
name: gdaonewindow
desc:
DEPRECATED - use -gdalayout.

For Arena Model:

Windowed mode: instead of 4 windows, create 1 window.

Fullscreen mode: instead of requiring 4 monitors, use only the primary monitor. WARNING: requires 4K monitor.

To access the subscreen, use the subscreen overlay.

title: GitaDora Arena Layout (EXPERIMENTAL)
name: gdalayout
desc:
For Arena Model: select how many windows to create.

1 window: main only; use the subscreen overlay for SMALL.

2 windows: main + SMALL. Without -w, this uses native D3D9 adapter-group fullscreen with physical MAIN/SMALL and virtual LEFT/RIGHT. It requires two active displays on one adapter group. With -w, it uses borderless windows instead.

4 windows: main + LEFT + RIGHT + SMALL. Fullscreen requires exactly 4 monitors in the right resolution; see wiki for details.

title: GitaDora Arena Subscreen Layout (EXPERIMENTAL)
name: gdasublayout
desc:
For Arena Model full screen two-window mode: select the image layout on the second monitor.

portrait (default): default subscreen @ 800x1280

landscape: pillarboxed subscreen @ 1920x1080

combine: LEFT + SMALL + RIGHT screens side by side @ 1920x1080

For landscape and combine, -forceressub can be used to override the resolution.

title: GitaDora Arena ASIO driver
name: gdaasio
desc:
For Arena Model: ASIO driver name to use in place of XONAR. String should match a subkey under HKLM\SOFTWARE\ASIO\

Requires 7.1 @ 48kHz; if the game rejects your ASIO device, it will automatically fall back to using WASAPI.

If the game crashes after successful ASIO init, try enabling -gdafakerealtek.

title: GitaDora Arena ASIO Allow Headphones
name: gdarealtek
desc:
For Arena Model: allow the game to access the Realtek audio for headphone output.

After opening ASIO device, the game then tries to look for audio devices named Realtek to open a second audio stream. For compatibility, spice prevents the game from doing this, but enabling this option will allow the game to access the Realtek audio device again.

name: jb
desc: Manually enable Jubeat module.

name: rb
desc: Manually enable Reflec Beat module.

name: dea

title: Force Load Chase Chase Jokers Module
name: ccj

title: Force Load QuizKnock STADIUM Module

title: Force Load Card Connect Module

title: Modules Folder Override
name: modules
desc: Sets a custom path to the modules folder.

title: Screenshot Folder Override
name: screenshotpath
desc: Sets a custom path to the screenshots folder.

title: Configuration Path Override
name: cfgpath
desc: Sets a custom file path for config file. Must be passed via the command line. If left empty, %appdata%\spicetools.xml will be used.

title: Screen Resize Config Path Override
name: resizecfgpath
desc: Sets a custom file path for screen resize config file. If left empty, %appdata%\spice2x\spicetools_screen_resize.json will be used.

title: Patch Manager Config Path Override
name: patchcfgpath
desc: Sets a custom file path for patch manager config file. Can be used to manage 'profiles' for auto-patches. If left empty, %appdata%\spice2x\spicetools_patch_manager.json will be used.

title: Intel SDE
name: sde
desc: Path to Intel SDE kit path for automatic attaching.

title: ea3-config.xml Override
name: e
desc: Sets a custom path to ea3-config.xml.

title: app-config.xml Override
name: a
desc: Sets a custom path to app-config.xml.

title: avs-config.xml Override
name: v
desc: Sets a custom path to avs-config.xml.

title: bootstrap.xml Override
name: b
desc: Sets a custom path to bootstrap.xml.

title: log.txt Override
name: y
desc: Sets a custom path to log.txt.

title: API TCP Port
name: api
desc: Port the API should be listening on.

title: API Password
name: apipass
desc: Set the custom user password needed to use the API.

title: API Verbose Logging
name: apilogging
desc: Verbose logging of API activity.

title: API Serial Port
name: apiserial
desc: Serial port the API should be listening on.

title: API Serial Baud
name: apiserialbaud
desc: Baud rate for the serial port.

title: API Pretty
name: apipretty
desc: Slower, but pretty API output.

title: API Debug Mode
name: apidebug
desc: Enables API debugging mode.

title: API Screen Mirror Quality Override
name: apiscreenq
desc: JPEG compression level of mirrored images, overriding any client request. Value must be between 0 (poor quality) and 100 (best quality), inclusive. Default: 70.

title: API Screen Mirror Divide Override
name: apiscreendiv
desc: Divide value of mirrored images, overriding any client request. Divide of 1 means send every pixel, 2 means every other pixel, 3 means every third pixel, and so on; increasing the value drastically reduces transfer size at the cost of image quality. Value must be 1 or greater. Default: 1.

title: API Video Stream Server Enable (EXPERIMENTAL)
name: apistream
desc:
Allows companion apps to receive compressed video streams over the API. Companion app must support this feature to take advantage of it.

Video is served unencrypted over the network. May cause older games to hang and crash.

Developers: see the wiki page for more details.

title: Enable All IO Modules
name: io
desc: Manually enable ALL IO emulation.

title: Enable ACIO Module
name: acio
desc: Manually enable ACIO emulation.

title: Enable ICCA Module
name: icca
desc: Manually enable ICCA emulation.

title: Enable DEVICE Module
name: device
desc: Manually enable DEVICE emulation.

title: Enable EXTDEV Module
name: extdev
desc: Manually enable EXTDEV emulation.

title: Enable AMI2000 Module
name: ami2000
desc: Manually enable AMI2000 emulation.

title: Enable SCIUNIT Module
name: sciunit
desc: Manually enable SCIUNIT emulation.

title: Enable device passthrough
name: devicehookdisable
desc: Disable I/O and serial device hooks.

title: Touch Compatibility Mode (Disable Raw Input Touch)
name: wintouch
desc: For touch screen input, disable usage of Raw Input API and instead use Win8 Pointer API or Win7 Touch API. Results in better compatibility with some touch screens, but may result in worse performance and higher latency.

title: Force Legacy Touch Emulation
name: touchemuforce
desc: Force enable hook for GetTouchInputInfo API and inject WM_TOUCH events. Do not enable this unless you have trouble with using a mouse to emulate touch input.

title: Invert Touch
name: touchinvert
desc: Inverts touch coordinates; only works for default raw input handler and IIDX/SDVX native touch handler, and not Windows Touch API.

title: Raw Input Touch Fix Aspect Ratio
name: rawtouchaspect
desc:
Compensate for letterboxing/pillarboxing when the game runs at a display mode with a different aspect ratio than the touch panel's native resolution. Only affects the default raw input touch handler. This is automatically enabled, only force on or off if you have trouble.

auto (default): automatically enable on a per-game basis.
on: forced on
off: forced off

title: Disable Touch Card Insert (DEPRECATED - use -touchcard instead)
name: touchnocard
desc: Disables touch overlay card insert button.

title: Show Insert Card button (DEPRECATED)
name: sp2x-touchcard
desc: Show Insert Card touch button on main display. DEPRECATED - only works in very specific situations (jubeat + wintouch)

title: ICCA Reader Port
name: reader
desc: Connects to and uses a ICCA on a given COM port.

title: ICCA Reader Port (with toggle)
name: togglereader
desc: Connects to and uses a ICCA on a given COM port, and enabled NumLock toggling between P1/P2.

title: CardIO HID Reader Support
name: cardio
desc: Enables detection and support of cardio HID readers.

title: CardIO HID Reader Order Flip
name: cardioflip
desc: Flips the order of detection for P1/P2.

title: CardIO HID Reader Order Toggle
name: cardiotoggle
desc: Toggles reader between P1/P2 using the NumLock key state.

title: HID SmartCard (ACR122U)
name: scard
desc: Detects and uses HID smart card readers for card input. Developed for ACR122U reader.

title: HID SmartCard Order Flip
name: scardflip
desc: Flips the order of detection for P1/P2.

title: HID SmartCard Order Toggle
name: scardtoggle
desc: Toggles reader between P1/P2 using the NumLock key state.

title: HID SmartCard Fix UID
name: scardfix
desc:
Modify behavior of SmartCard UID logic.

legacy (default): Preserve buggy old behavior

fix: Add E00401 to non-FeliCa cards, scan FeliCa cards as-is (Recommended for most users)

all: Add E00401 to all cards, including FeliCa cards (For really old games only)

The algorithm is simple; the prefix is applied, the scanned card number is appended up to 8 bytes, and remaining digits are discarded. For example, abcd56780123 is converted to e00401abcd567801 on card in. This results in different card numbers so be careful when connecting to servers!

title: SextetStream Port
name: sextet
desc: Use a SextetStream device on a given COM port.

title: Enable BemaniTools 5 API
name: bt5api
desc: Enables partial BemaniTools 5 API compatibility layer.

title: Realtime Process Priority (DEPRECATED - use -processpriority instead)
name: realtime
desc: Sets the process priority to realtime; can help with odd lag spikes.

title: Process Priority
name: sp2x-processpriority
desc: Sets the process priority, which can help with odd lag spikes. Default: high.

title: Process Affinity
name: sp2x-processaffinity
desc: Set process affinity by calling SetProcessAffinityMask. Must provide a hexadecimal mask (e.g., 0x1ff00).

title: Process Efficiency Class
name: sp2x-processefficiency
desc: Has no effect if -processaffinity is set. Default: Use all cores.

title: Heap Size
name: h
desc: Custom heap size in bytes.

title: NVIDIA profile optimization
name: sp2x-nvprofile
desc:
Creates an NVIDIA application profile for spice(64).exe and applies GPU tweaks.

Disables G-SYNC by setting the Monitor Technology to 'Fixed Refresh', sets v-sync to 'Application Controlled', and the Power Management Mode to 'Prefer maximum performance'.

G-SYNC may fail to disable properly; try enabling full-screen optimizations (FSO) for spice(64).exe.

May not work as expected for some games; namely G-SYNC and SDVX.

title: Disable All Spice Audio Hooks
name: audiohookdisable
desc:
Disables all audio hooks, including device initialization and volume hooks.

Default: off (allow Spice to hook IMMDeviceEnumerator for and optionally let you use a different backend instead of exclusive WASAPI).

Check this to allow games to natively access your audio device.

title: Disable Audio Volume Hook
name: sp2x-volumehookdisable
desc:
Disables audio volume hook.

Default: off (prevent games from changing audio volume by hooking IAudioEndpointVolume).

Check this to allow games to freely change your volume.

title: WASAPI Force Shared Mode & Auto-Resample (EXPERIMENTAL)
name: wasapishared
desc:
This option converts all WASAPI exclusive mode requests to shared mode.

Many games have patches that turn on shared mode, but this option is better! Windows will automatically perform sample rate conversion - you do not need to manually set the sample rate of your audio device before launching the game.

title: Low Latency Shared Audio
name: sp2x-lowlatencysharedaudio
desc: Force the usage of smallest buffer size supported by the device when shared mode audio is used. Works for games using DirectSound or shared WASAPI; no effect for exclusive WASAPI and ASIO. For best results (under 10ms), use the default Windows inbox audio driver instead of manufacturer supplied driver. Requires Windows 10 and above.

title: Spice Audio Hook Backend (DEPRECATED - use -asioconvert instead)
name: audiobackend
desc: Selects the audio backend to use when spice audio hook is enabled, overriding exclusive WASAPI. Does nothing for games that do not output to exclusive WASAPI.

title: Spice Audio Hook ASIO Driver ID (DEPRECATED - use -asioconvert instead)
name: asiodriverid
desc: Selects the ASIO driver id to use when Spice Audio Backend is set to ASIO.

title: WASAPI Exclusive to ASIO Conversion
name: asioconvert
desc:
Converts WASAPI Exclusive audio output to ASIO. Value here should match registry key under HKLM\SOFTWARE\ASIO\

Use this if the game is configured to use WASAPI Exclusive but you want to use your ASIO driver instead.

This should only be used as last resort if your audio device does not support WASAPI Exclusive.

Does nothing for games that do not output to exclusive WASAPI.

title: WASAPI Dummy Context
name: audiodummy
desc: Uses a dummy `IAudioClient` context to maintain full audio control. This is automatically enabled when required and not normally needed.

title: WASAPI Stereo Downmix
name: downmix
desc:
Downmixes multi-channel (surround) audio output to stereo.

Note that in all of the options, subwoofer (LFE) is dropped.

ac4 (recommended): AC-4 algorithm (ETSI TS 103 190-1) - front left/right pass through, center and surrounds fold in at -3 dB.

normalize: all channels equally loud.

front: front channels only.

rear: rear channels only.

side: side channels only.

title: WASAPI/ASIO Boost Audio Volume
name: volumeboost
desc:
Artificially amplifies the hooked audio output by the selected amount, applied right before the audio reaches the device. Works regardless of channel layout or downmixing.

Louder settings may cause clipping/distortion, use caution.

title: WASAPI Exclusive Mode Resampling
name: resample
desc:
Resamples the hooked audio output to a fixed sample rate before it reaches the device. Useful when a game requests a sample rate the device cannot output in exclusive mode (e.g. the game wants 44100 Hz but the device is locked to 48000 Hz).

Select the TARGET sample rate (one that your audio card supports).

Will result in couple milliseconds of latency and increased CPU usage when active.

title: WASAPI Exclusive Buffer Size
name: exclusivebuffer
desc:
Enlarges the WASAPI exclusive-mode device buffer to the specified duration in milliseconds.

Try setting this to 10 or even 20 if you hear crackling or glitches (at the cost of slightly increased latency).

title: ASIO 7.1 to Stereo Downmix
name: asiodownmix
desc:
Extracts a single stereo channel pair from a multi-channel ASIO output, mapping the selected pair to the device's first two channels.

Channel pairs assume a standard 7.1 ASIO layout (0-indexed):

front: channels 0/1 (front left/right).

center: channel 2 (front center, duplicated to both outputs).

rear: channels 4/5 (rear left/right).

side: channels 6/7 (side left/right).

title: Delay by 5 Seconds (DEPRECATED - use -sleepduration instead)
name: sleep
desc: Waits five seconds before starting the game.

title: Delay Game Launch
name: sp2x-sleepduration
desc: Wait for N seconds before starting the game.

title: Load KBT/KLD Stubs
name: stubs
desc: Enables loading kbt/kld stub files.

title: Adjust Display Orientation (DEPRECATED - use -autoorientation instead)
name: adjustorientation
desc: Automatically adjust the orientation of your display in portrait games. WARNING: game may launch at incorrect refresh rate! Use in combination with -graphics-force-refresh flag to fix.

title: Rotate Monitor
name: sp2x-autoorientation
desc: Change the orientation of the primary display before launching the game. It will be restored on exit

title: Change Monitor Resolution
name: changeres
desc: Changes monitor resolution before booting the game.

title: AVS Log Level
name: loglevel
desc: Set the level of detail for AVS log messages written to the log. Does not affect logging from spice.

title: EA Automap
name: automap
desc: Enable automap in patch configuration.

title: EA Netdump
name: netdump
desc: Enable automap in network dumping configuration.

title: Blocking Logger
name: logblock
desc: Slower but safer logging for debugging.

title: Debug CreateFile
name: createfiledebug
desc: Outputs CreateFile debug prints.

title: Verbose Graphics Logging
name: graphicsverbose
desc: Enable the verbose logging of graphics hook code.

title: Verbose AVS Logging
name: avsverbose
desc: Enable the verbose logging of AVS filesystem functions.

title: Allow EA3 Verbose Debug Logging
name: ea3verbose
desc:
This option is only useful for network developers; leave this OFF.

By default, ea3/debug/verbose node is removed by spice to prevent exposing PCBID in the logs. When this is enabled, ea3/debug/verbose node in the XML will be kept and exposed to the game.

title: Disable Colored Output
name: nocolor
desc: Disable terminal colors for log outputs to console.

title: Disable ACP Hook
name: acphookdisable
desc: Force disable advanced code pages hooks for encoding.

title: Disable Signal Handling
name: signaldisable
desc: Force disable signal handling.

title: Disable Debug Hooks
name: dbghookdisable
desc: Disable hooks for debug functions (e.g. OutputDebugString).

title: Disable AVS VFS Drive Mount Redirection
name: avs-redirect-disable
desc: Disable D:/E:/F: AVS VFS mount redirection.

title: Disable AVS Cache
name: avscachedisable
desc: Disable optimization used for some games to cache data file info (only for IIDX32+ for now).

title: Output PEB
name: pebprint
desc: Prints PEB on startup to console.

title: Dump System Information
name: sysdump
desc: Print system information to the log on startup. Default: basic.

title: QKS Arguments Override
name: qksargs
desc: Command line arguments passed to the game.

title: CCJ Arguments Override
name: ccjargs
desc: Command line arguments passed to the game. If left blank, '-nomatchselect' is applied, which disables matchmaking debug menu.

title: CCJ Mouse Trackball
name: ccjmousetb
desc: Use mouse for trackball input; disables any keyboard / joystick control for the trackball. Hold RMB and move the cursor to control the trackball.

title: CCJ Mouse Trackball Toggle
name: ccjmousetbt
desc: Instead of holding RMB, click RMB to toggle trackball input.

title: CCJ Trackball Sensitivity
name: ccjtrackballsens
desc: Adjust sensitivity of trackball. Affects both digital and analog input. Default: 10.

title: MFG Arguments Override
name: mfgargs
desc: Command line arguments passed to the game.

title: MFG Cabinet Type
name: mfgcabtype
desc: MFG Cabinet Type. Default is HG.

title: MFG Disable IO Emulation
name: mfgnoio
desc: Disables BI2X hooks for MFG.

title: PC Arguments Override
name: pcargs
desc: Command line arguments passed to the game.

title: PC Disable IO Emulation
name: pcnoio
desc: Disables BI2X hooks for PC.

title: PC Fader Knobs Mode
name: pcknobs
desc: Allows SDVX knobs and IIDX turntables to be bound as Polaris Chord faders.

title: DANCE aROUND Arguments Override
name: udnargs
desc: Command line arguments passed to the game.

title: DANCE aROUND Disable IO Emulation
name: udnnoio
desc: Disables BI2X hooks for DANCE aROUND.

title: Card Connect Arguments Override
name: cardconnectargs
desc: Command line arguments passed to the game.

title: Card Connect Disable Printer Emulation
name: cardconnectnoprinter
desc: Leave the native printer driver unhooked for use with a real printer.

title: Card Connect Simulate Printer Delay
name: cardconnectprinterdelay
desc: Simulate real printing time: 73 seconds per card, plus hologram and coating delays (up to 99 seconds). Off by default (5 seconds per card).

title: Card Connect Printer Output Path
name: cardconnectprinterpath
desc: Folder for front/back color images. Defaults to the working directory.

title: Card Connect Printer Output Clear
name: cardconnectprinterclear
desc: Delete saved front/back images in the output directory on startup.

title: Card Connect Printer Output Overwrite
name: cardconnectprinteroverwrite
desc: Always overwrite the same front/back image pair.

title: Card Connect Printer Output Format
name: cardconnectprinterformat
desc: File format for printer output. Defaults to PNG.

title: Card Connect Printer JPG Quality
name: cardconnectprinterjpgquality
desc: Quality setting in percent if JPG format is used.

title: Lights Brightness Adjustment
name: sp2x-lights-brightness
desc: Modify HID output values, measured in %. Default is 100. Requires compatible hardware, not just any LED.

title: Window Border Style
name: sp2x-windowborder
desc: For windowed mode: overrides window border style. Does not work for all games; can possibly make the game crash! Can also be changed in Screen Resize window (default F11).

title: Window Size
name: sp2x-windowsize
desc: For windowed mode: override for window size, width and height separated by comma. Can also be changed in Screen Resize window (default F11).

title: Window Position
name: sp2x-windowpos
desc: For windowed mode: override for window position, x and y separated by comma. Can also be changed in Screen Resize window (default F11).

title: Window Always on Top
name: sp2x-windowalwaysontop
desc: For windowed mode: make window to be always on top of other windows. Can also be changed in Screen Resize window (default F11).

title: Window Forced Render Scaling
name: windowscale
desc: For windowed mode: forcibly set DX9 back buffer dimensions to match window size. Reduces pixelated scaling artifacts. Works great for some games, but can COMPLETELY BREAK other games - YMMV!

title: Disable Round Window Corners
name: windownoroundcorners
desc: Windows 11 and above only: Disables rounded corners on the game window(s).

title: GitaDora Windowed Main Monitor
name: gdwmainmonitor
desc: For GITADORA Arena windowed mode: place and size the main window to fill this monitor.

title: GitaDora Windowed LEFT Monitor
name: gdwleftmonitor
desc: For GITADORA Arena windowed mode: place and size the LEFT window to fill this monitor.

title: GitaDora Windowed RIGHT Monitor
name: gdwrightmonitor
desc: For GITADORA Arena windowed mode: place and size the RIGHT window to fill this monitor.

title: GitaDora Windowed SMALL Monitor
name: gdwsmallmonitor
desc: For GITADORA Arena windowed mode: place and size the SMALL touch window to fill this monitor.

title: GitaDora Windowed SMALL Size
name: gdwsmallsize
desc: Size of the GITADORA Arena SMALL touch window. Defaults to (800,1280).

title: GitaDora Windowed SMALL Position
name: gdwsmallpos
desc: Initial position of the GITADORA Arena SMALL touch window. Defaults to (0,0).

title: IIDX Windowed Subscreen Size
name: iidxwsubsize
desc: Size of the subscreen window. Defaults to (1280,720).

title: IIDX Windowed Subscreen Position
name: iidxwsubpos
desc: Initial position of the subscreen window. Defaults to (0,0).

title: IIDX Windowed Subscreen Borderless
name: iidxwsubborderless
desc: Remove window decoration from windowed subscreen.

title: IIDX Windowed Subscreen Always On Top
name: iidxwsubtop
desc: Keep windowed subscreen on top.

title: JB Legacy Touch Targets (Deprecated - use -jubeattouchalgo instead)
name: sp2x-jubeatlegacytouch
desc: Deprecated - use -jubeattouchalgo instead.

title: JB Touch Algorithm
name: jubeattouchalgo
desc:
For touch screen players: choose the touch algorithm to use.

legacy - evenly divide the grid into 16 squares; old spicetools behavior, slightly inaccurate in gaps

improved (default) - squares register as-is, gaps will trigger the closest square

plus - like improved, but gaps can trigger multiple buttons (like the mobile game)

accurate - only touches within squares will trigger; gaps do nothing (for AC size touch screens)

title: JB Touch Debug Overlay
name: jubeattouchdebug
desc:
For touch screen players: draw a debug overlay on the main display. Requires the Spice Overlay to be enabled.

auto (default) - show boundary boxes when a touch screen is detected; otherwise, none

none - draw nothing

box - show the 4x4 touch boundary boxes

all - show both the boxes and the touch circles

title: JB Touch Debounce
name: jubeattouchdebounce
desc:
For touch screen players: ignore extremely quick touches by requiring a touch to be held for at least this many milliseconds before it registers.

Useful for filtering phantom touches on a noisy touch screen. A higher value adds input latency, so keep it small. Default: off (0).

title: RB Touch Debug Overlay
name: rbtouchdebug
desc:
Draw lines to show IR sensor emulation state.

Note: lines will not perfectly align with touches; this is by design, it's showing the IR sensor state, before the game applies its own touch detection algorithm.

title: RB Touch Emulation Scale
name: sp2x-rbscaletouch
desc: Apply scaling to make touch area smaller than the screen. Specify a number out of 1000 (e.g., 800 means 80%). Default: 1000.

title: RB Touch Emulation Size (DEPRECATED - no longer has any effect)
name: rbtouchsize
desc: This option is deprecated and no longer has any effect. Reflec Beat touch emulation always uses the 3x3 sensor model.

title: RB Touch Emulation Poll Hz
name: rbtouchhz
desc:
By default, the game polls for touch at ~125Hz. This option overrides that rate; enter a number between 1 and 1000.

Higher rates reduce input latency (the game sees a fresher touch position) but do NOT improve spatial accuracy, and very high rates just waste CPU.

title: ASIO Force Unload On Stop
name: sp2x-asioforceunload
desc: For certain buggy ASIO drivers, force unload of ASIO driver when audio stream stops. Used for working around ASIO drivers that lock up after force quitting games.

title: IIDX Disable E-spec I/O
name: sp2x-iidxnoespec
desc: Disable I/O emulation for E-spec I/O upgrade (GELDJ-JX kit).

title: IIDX TDJ Windowed Mode (DEPRECATED - just use -iidxtdj and -w together)
name: sp2x-iidxtdjw
desc: Enable TDJ, optimized for windowed mode. Press Toggle Subscreen button and use your mouse on the main window.

title: DRS Disable Touch Input
name: sp2x-drsdisabletouch
desc: Disables multitouch input.

title: DRS Transpose Touch Input
name: sp2x-drstransposetouch
desc: Swap x and y values of touch input.

title: DRS RGB Camera Hook
name: drsrgbcamhook
desc:
Hook into the RGB camera detection and attempt to use your own non-official webcam. Not every webcam will be compatible with this; YMMV.

Note: this is NOT for the motion camera - you still need a real RealSense camera for that!

title: IIDX Native Touch (DEPRECATED - no longer needed)
name: sp2x-iidxnativetouch
desc:
This option does nothing.

Native touch handling is now enabled by default and this option is no longer needed.

title: IIDX TDJ Subscreen Disable
name: sp2x-iidxnosub
desc: Prevents TDJ subscreen from launching a separate window.

title: IIDX TDJ Subscreen Monitor Override
name: iidxsubmonitor
desc: If you have three or more monitors, this option can be set to tell the game which monitor is the subscreen.

title: IIDX TDJ Subscreen Keypad Touch Emulation
name: sp2x-iidxsubpoke
desc: Emulates touches on TDJ subscreen when keypad input is received. Should be used along with 'Unscramble Touch Screen Keypad in TDJ' patch. 00 is mapped to erase button, and Decimal shows/hides the keypad.

title: Auto Card Insert
name: sp2x-autocard
desc: Periodically present virtual card(s) to the reader, removing the need to press Insert Card button. Only applies to local virtual cards (-card0, -card1, or card0/1.txt), do not use with physical card reader or API.

title: Tape LED Avg Algorithm
name: sp2x-tapeledalgo
desc: For games with light arrays, determine the algorithm that is used to translate them into a single light binding in Lights tab. Default: mid.

title: NVAPI Block
name: sp2x-nonvapi
desc: Completely block the game from accessing NVAPI. Can be used if NVAPI is returning undesirable results to the game (e.g., wrong values from NvDisplayConfig for SDVX). You may need to apply additional hex edits to boot the game correctly.

title: Disable D3D9 Device Hook (DEPRECATED - no longer needed for TDJ recording)
name: sp2x-nod3d9devhook
desc: This was previously required for TDJ play recording, but as of 2024-08-04, it is no longer needed. Completely disable all DXD9 device hook, preventing features like Spice overlay, subscreen window, screenshots, screen resize, touch emulation, streaming to Companion, etc.

title: SDVX Subscreen Disable
name: sp2x-sdvxnosub
desc: Prevents VM subscreen from launching a separate window.

title: SDVX Full Screen Landscape Mode (SDVX5+, EXPERIMENTAL)
name: sdvxlandscape
desc:
Allows you to play in landscape by transposing resolution and applying image scaling.

Corrects the in-game perspective camera for the transposed display aspect ratio.

Works only for SDVX5 and above.

Will launch at 1080p by default; strongly consider combining this with -forceres option to render at monitor native resolution.

title: StepManiaX Stage Lighting Support
name: sp2x-smx-stage
desc: StepmaniaX stage will show up as a device that can receive lighting output. For configurator, restart spicecfg.exe after enabling this to have the device show up for binding.

title: StepManiaX Dedicated Cabinet Lighting Support
name: sp2x-smx-dedicab
desc: StepManiaX Dedicated Cabinet will show up as a device that can receive lighting output. For configurator, restart spicecfg.exe after enabling this to have the device show up for binding.

title: IIDX Recording Quality
name: iidxreccqp
desc:
WARNING: double check if your network allows this & your hardware supports it.

For TDJ Play Record feature, specify ConstQP quality settings for NVENC. Lower is higher quality but bigger file.

Two options: specify a single number (20) to set CQ Level, or specify comma-separated numbers (23,25,20) to set P, B, I levels.

title: IIDX Recording Force Disable
name: iidxnorec
desc: When enabled, this prevents the play record feature from being used.

title: MIDI Note Input Algorithm
name: midialgo
desc:
Remember to restart after changing this value.

Switch algorithm used for MIDI note handling.

auto (default): use v2 for most games, v2_drum for DrumMania and FutureTomTom

v2: new delta-time logic in spice2x, timestamp every on/off events and apply min. sustain period to rapid on/off triggers, supports velocity threshold

v2_drum: same as v2, but disable holds; better for some drum kits

legacy: legacy poll-based spicetools logic, may behave incorrectly when the same input is mapped to multiple buttons, no support for velocity threshold.

title: MIDI Note Min. Sustain
name: midisustain
desc:
Remember to restart after changing this value. Only affects v2 MIDI algorithm. Does not affect spicecfg.

Set the minimum duration (in milliseconds) each note is sustained, so that the game's I/O can pick up the input when polled.

If this is too short, when game polls for input, it may fail to observe quick input (such as drums). If this is too long, rapid hits may be dropped due to coalescing.

Recommended to keep at default of 20ms unless you have issues.

title: DDR P4IO Buffer Algorithm
name: ddrp4iobuffer
desc:
Remember to restart after changing this value.

Sets the algorithm used to populate entries to the buffer of controller polls read by the game.

auto (default): thread mode if <120Hz, backfill if >=120Hz

thread: starts a thread to periodically insert polls into the buffer

backfill: fills the buffer on each frame with last known state info at short regular intervals up to the current time, then writes the current state.

Only has an effect when emulating P4IO (arkmdxp4.dll).

title: Input Requires Focus
name: inputfocus
desc:
Determine input behavior when game window is not in focus.

never: allow input regardless of focus
naive (default): only naive bindings check for window focus, rawinput binds are always allowed
always: only process input when window is in focus.

title: Nost Screen Poke
name: nostpoke
desc:
Enables emulation of touch gestures to make it easier to navigate the game without a touchscreen.

This enables two things:
  1. Swipe/Touch bindings in Buttons tab (Swipe Next Page, etc)
  2. PIN pad bindings (make sure Unscramble Keypad patch is applied).

title: Nostalgia Touch Piano
name: nosttouch
desc:
Allows you to play the piano by touching the screen instead of a controller. Use the mode switch button to toggle between interacting with the menu and playing the piano.

Velocity sensitivity is not supported. Touch targets will be pixel-perfect aligned with the judgement line, key beams, and notes.

title: V-Sync Buffering
name: vsyncbuffer
desc: Using triple buffering may improve cases of micro-stuttering but increases input latency.

title: SDVX Windowed Subscreen Size
name: sdvxwsubsize
desc: Size of the subscreen window. Defaults to (1920,1080).

title: SDVX Windowed Subscreen Position
name: sdvxwsubpos
desc: Initial position of the subscreen window. Defaults to (0,0).

title: SDVX Windowed Subscreen Borderless
name: sdvxwsubborderless
desc: Remove window decoration from windowed subscreen.

title: SDVX Windowed Subscreen Always On Top
name: sdvxwsubtop
desc: Keep windowed subscreen on top.

title: LovePlus Camera Enable
name: lovepluscam
desc: Allow game to access camera; camera must be compatible with game.

title: LovePlus Printer Output Path
name: lpprinterpath
desc: Path to folder where images will be stored.

title: LovePlus Printer Output Clear
name: lpprinterclear
desc: Clean up saved images in the output directory on startup.

title: LovePlus Printer Output Overwrite
name: lpprinteroverwrite
desc: Always overwrite the same file in output directory.

title: LovePlus Printer Output Format
name: lpprinterformat
desc: File format for printer output.

title: LovePlus Printer JPG Quality
name: lpprinterjpgquality
desc: Quality setting in percent if JPG format is used.

title: Command Line Args Override
name: cmdoverride
desc:
By default, option values in spicecfg take precedence over command-line args, for legacy compat.
When this is specified in command line, command-line args take precedence instead.

title: Otoca Camera Check Bypass
name: otocacamhook
desc: This game REQUIRES a (compatible) webcam to save progress. If you don't have any, check this option to bypass camera error during boot, allowing you to try out the game.

title: Use Legacy Timers
name: notimerhacks
desc: Disables high resolution timers, reverting to legacy behavior. Recommended that you leave this OFF for optimal input latency, unless you're on a resource-constrained system (e.g., old cabinet PC)

title: Enable ICMP Emulation
name: icmphook
desc: Emulate keepalive ping replies in user mode, so the game does not need to open privileged raw ICMP sockets.

title: NIC Spoof
name: nicspoof
desc:
Use with -icmphook.

offline: report a fake Ethernet IPv4 adapter and map DNS names to that address so the game can boot when no real NIC is present. Does not create a real adapter.

tunnelhost: same fake NIC, plus listen for a matching tunnel from a peer.

tunnelclient: same fake NIC, plus connect to a tunnel host. Set -nicspoofhostrealip.

title: NIC Spoof IP
name: nicspoofip
desc:
Overlay IPv4 for the fake adapter. Used when NIC Spoof is not Default. If unset, 10.100.100.10 is used.

Must be on the same subnet as gateway 10.100.100.1 with mask 255.0.0.0 (10.0.0.0/8). Examples: 10.100.100.10, 10.0.0.10. Do not use 10.0.0.0, 10.255.255.255, the gateway 10.100.100.1, or DNS 10.2.1.10 / 10.2.1.30. Host and client must use different IPs.

title: NIC Spoof Tunnel Host
name: nicspoofhostrealip
desc: Real IP address or hostname of the tunnel host. Required for tunnel client mode. Not used for offline or tunnel host.

title: NIC Spoof Tunnel Port
name: nicspoofport
desc: UDP port for the matching tunnel. Host listens on this port; client connects to it. If unset, 51820 is used.

title: Run as
name: runas
desc:
Controls whether spice will automatically re-launch with administrator privileges at startup.

admin (default): automatically re-launch with administrator privileges, needed for most games to function properly

user: skip elevation, run with current user privileges; game may fail to launch, crash, or critical features may silently fail; use at your own risk.

title: Configurator Force Software Rendering
name: forcesoftware
desc: Forces the use of software rendering instead of hardware acceleration for the configurator.

title: OBS WebSocket Enable
name: obsenable
desc: Enables the in-game OBS Control overlay and its connection to the OBS Studio obs-websocket (v5) server.

title: OBS WebSocket Host
name: obshost
desc: Host name or IP address of the OBS Studio obs-websocket (v5) server used by the in-game OBS Control overlay. Defaults to 127.0.0.1 when left empty.

title: OBS WebSocket Port
name: obsport
desc: Port of the OBS Studio obs-websocket (v5) server. Defaults to 4455 when left empty.

title: OBS WebSocket Password
name: obspass
desc: Password for the OBS Studio obs-websocket (v5) server. Leave empty if authentication is disabled in OBS.

title: OBS WebSocket Debug
name: obsdebug
desc: Writes the OBS WebSocket client's internal connection diagnostics to the log. Only enable this when troubleshooting connection problems.

title: Include Overlay in Screenshots
name: screenshotoverlay
desc: Includes Spice overlay in screenshots.

title: Include Subscreens in Screenshots
name: screenshotsub
desc: Saves each subscreen as a separate PNG alongside the primary screenshot.
